Which customers received product made wi:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.channel,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sl.shipment_id) AS shipments,
       SUM(sl.cases_shipped) AS cases_shipped
FROM gold.bridge_lot_ingredient AS b
JOIN gold.fact_shipment_line AS sl ON sl.lot_id = b.lot_id
JOIN gold.fact_shipment AS s ON s.shipment_id = sl.shipment_id
JOIN gold.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE b.ingredient_lot_id = 'ILOT-P04-ING14-20260818'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.channel
ORDER BY cases_shipped DESC;
Which ingredient lots and suppliers went:
SELECT b.lot_id, i.ingredient_name, b.ingredient_lot_id, s.supplier_name, r.receipt_date, r.supplier_lot_ref
FROM gold.bridge_lot_ingredient AS b
JOIN gold.dim_ingredient AS i ON i.ingredient_id = b.ingredient_id
JOIN gold.fact_ingredient_receipt AS r ON r.ingredient_lot_id = b.ingredient_lot_id
JOIN gold.dim_supplier AS s ON s.supplier_id = r.supplier_id
WHERE b.lot_id = 'LP03-260805-001'
ORDER BY i.ingredient_name;
What was the waste rate by facility and:
WITH produced AS (
  SELECT l.facility_id, p.category, SUM(l.cases_produced) AS cases_produced
  FROM gold.fact_lot AS l
  JOIN gold.dim_product AS p ON p.sku_id = l.sku_id
  WHERE l.production_date >= '2026-07-01' AND l.production_date < '2026-08-01'
  GROUP BY l.facility_id, p.category
), wasted AS (
  SELECT w.facility_id, p.category, SUM(w.cases) AS cases_wasted
  FROM gold.fact_waste AS w
  JOIN gold.dim_product AS p ON p.sku_id = w.sku_id
  WHERE w.waste_date >= '2026-07-01' AND w.waste_date < '2026-08-01'
    AND w.reason IN ('Aged Out', 'Damaged', 'QA Reject')
  GROUP BY w.facility_id, p.category
)
SELECT pr.facility_id, pr.category, pr.cases_produced,
       COALESCE(wa.cases_wasted, 0) AS cases_wasted,
       CAST(100.0 * COALESCE(wa.cases_wasted, 0) / pr.cases_produced AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS waste_rate_pct
FROM produced AS pr
LEFT JOIN wasted AS wa ON wa.facility_id = pr.facility_id AND wa.category = pr.category
ORDER BY waste_rate_pct DESC;
What was OTIF % by shipping facility in:
WITH order_in_full AS (
  SELECT order_id,
         CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN cases_delivered = cases_ordered THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_full
  FROM gold.fact_order_line
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT s.ship_from_facility_id,
       COUNT(*) AS shipments,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.on_time = 1 AND f.in_full = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS otif_pct
FROM gold.fact_shipment AS s
JOIN order_in_full AS f ON f.order_id = s.order_id
WHERE s.requested_delivery_ts >= '2026-07-01' AND s.requested_delivery_ts < '2026-08-01'
GROUP BY s.ship_from_facility_id
ORDER BY otif_pct ASC;
What were the top 5 best-selling product:
SELECT TOP 5 p.sku_id, p.sku_name, SUM(ol.cases_delivered) AS cases_delivered
FROM gold.fact_order_line AS ol
JOIN gold.dim_product AS p ON p.sku_id = ol.sku_id
WHERE ol.requested_delivery_date >= '2026-08-01' AND ol.requested_delivery_date < '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY p.sku_id, p.sku_name
ORDER BY cases_delivered DESC;
Which lots failed a QA test at plant P03:
SELECT q.lot_id, l.sku_id, p.sku_name, q.test_type, q.tested_on, l.cases_produced
FROM gold.fact_quality_test AS q
JOIN gold.fact_lot AS l ON l.lot_id = q.lot_id
JOIN gold.dim_product AS p ON p.sku_id = l.sku_id
WHERE q.result = 'Fail' AND l.facility_id = 'P03'
ORDER BY q.tested_on;
How many finished lots, customers and ca:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.lot_id) AS finished_lots,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS customers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.shipment_id) AS shipments,
       SUM(t.cases_shipped) AS cases_shipped
FROM gold.trace_genealogy AS t
WHERE t.ingredient_lot_id = 'ILOT-P04-ING14-20260818';
